lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr₂Ni₄Si₆ (reduced formula CrNi₂Si₃) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁md (No. 143), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Cr centers with 12 neighbors (8 Ni, 4 Si; 2.54–2.75 Å), Ni centers with 11 neighbors (2 Cr, 4 Ni, 5 Si; 2.54–2.66 Å), and Si centers with 9 neighbors (2 Cr, 1 Ni, 6 Si; 2.46–2.75 Å). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Si-centered 9-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Cr- and Ni-centered polyhedra.
